comments.body: Still broken on build 2026.07.18 — inserting after Hello[space] yields Hello[space][space]@maya. The space-normalization branch never runs when $from.parentOffset is already a hard break plus space.

content.text: Still broken on build 2026.07.18 — inserting after Hello[space] yields Hello[space][space]@maya. The space-normalization branch never runs when $from.parentOffset is already a hard break plus space.
Typing @ in the editor opens mention autocomplete. Choosing a person inserts @handle but with an extra leading space when the caret was already after a space, producing two spaces before the at-sign.

Insertion should replace the trigger query with a single mention node and at most one separating space from the preceding word. The double space shows up in rendered comments and in notification previews as an awkward gap.

Mention plugin insertMention always prepends a space text node for word boundary, ignoring that the delete range already consumed a trailing space from the query. Reopened after the first fix only covered mid-word triggers, not triggers that start after punctuation-plus-space.

description_text:
Typing @ in the editor opens mention autocomplete. Choosing a person inserts @handle but with an extra leading space when the caret was already after a space, producing two spaces before the at-sign.
Insertion should replace the trigger query with a single mention node and at most one separating space from the preceding word. The double space shows up in rendered comments and in notification previews as an awkward gap.
Mention plugin insertMention always prepends a space text node for word boundary, ignoring that the delete range already consumed a trailing space from the query. Reopened after the first fix only covered mid-word triggers, not triggers that start after punctuation-plus-space.
